title: Apollo Global has built a risk assessment framework that categorizes software investments into 12 to 14 sectors to rank them by susceptibility to AI disruption (Hannah Webster/Bloomberg)
summary: Hannah Webster / Bloomberg: Apollo Global has built a risk assessment framework that categorizes software investments into 12 to 14 sectors to rank them by susceptibility to AI disruption — Apollo Global Management Inc. is assessing every new investment opportunity in the software industry for AI disruption risk …
